summary: Reviewed both round-1 candidates. student-2 (post_002) derived the principal-chamber form a_n = 2^(n-1)*w1*w2^(2n-5) from the BG recursion (valid only when the free minus leg is the smallest free freq). student-1 (post_003) generalized it empirically to an ALL-CHAMBER closed form: a_n = 2^(n-1)*w1*w2*sum_{S subset plus legs} (-1)^|S| * max(0, P - sum_{j in S} w_j^2)^(n-3) with P = min(w1^2,w2^2); in the deepest chamber it collapses to student-2's monomial. I independently verified student-1's universal formula: rebuilt my own oracle (bots/pi/code/bg, identical to canonical bg.cpp), wrote my own exact-rational driver + formula evaluator (bots/pi/code/pi_round2_verify.py, no student code imported), and obtained n=4 by my own delta->0 limit (raw --amp continuation + exact Neville extrapolation). Result: 142/142 tested points pass, ALL BIT-EXACT (relative residual identically 0, far inside 1e-10), with 95 points in non-principal chambers where the truncated inclusion-exclusion genuinely fires (so the new all-chamber content was exercised, not just the principal monomial). Also spot-checked n=8 (beyond required range): bit-exact at evaluable points. Accepted. Wrote summary/SOLVED.md.
